item.title: Springfield: Local bars feel ripple effect of MO's half-billion-dollar betting boom

item.title: Thawing for Groundhog Day, but cold may persist
item.description: After a cold snap, temperatures are expected to rise 10-15 degrees on Sunday, with a potential for flurries or light snow in the northeastern counties, and Groundhog Day looking lovely with temperatures in the upper 40s.

item.title: Can a groundhog predict the weather? A meteorologist explains
item.description: Punxsutawney Phil, the world's most famous forecaster, will emerge from hibernation tomorrow to reveal whether there will be six more weeks of winter or an early spring, though his accuracy has been around 30% over the past decade.

item.title: Inside Black Springfield's long Civil Rights fight for freedom
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. – The first homes were holes in the ground. Emma Ray remembered them clearly — dugouts scraped into the earth after emancipation, brush houses stitched together with whatever could be found. Freedom had arrived, but shelter had not.
